duplicate_control: Distinct observed episodes used once; no duplicated product-of-factors reader. Predictive states repeat across byte budgets exactly, not independent evidence.
limitations: The supplied eight-state endpoint channel and common codec/schema are shared external information, not charged to per-maker memory. Storage is actual per-maker serialized payload, not peak process RAM or full application cost.

Raw entries use 16-byte source digest plus index and four observed fields; compact ledger uses index plus fields and reconstructs source link by the declared hash. This format comparison is not an optimal compression lower bound.

Sufficient posterior and four-probability predictive head consume all permitted history once; raw/ledger inference sees only retained recent episodes. Hybrid stores full-history posterior plus as many recent ledger entries as fit.

Every historical order/inspection witness is observed in the input, but independent of endpoint emissions by construction. Predictive twins differ only in these witnesses; their identical predictive memory is an exact finite counterexample, not a human memory conclusion.
No execution shift is included; native-to-shift contrasts are unavailable for every reader. No fitted seeds, original-world headroom, F03 category or confirmation.
Distinct episodes are used once; no copied-evidence product reader exists in this miniature. Learned heads, dynamic maker changes and query-aware retention remain conditional.
